subject: general
question: ______ launched the Fit India Mobile App at an event at Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium, New Delhi in August 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anurag Singh Thakur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports (MYAS), Shri Anurag Singh Thakur would launch the Fit India Mobile Application on **29th August 2021.**
 
• The app would be available on both the Android and the iOS platforms and would work even on basic smartphones.
 
• The Fit India Movement was launched on 29th August 2019 with the vision of making India a Fit and Healthy Nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Youth Affairs and Sports Minister Anurag Singh Thakur launched six new and rare Reference Materials (RMs) on 3 April 2022.

 
 
• They have been developed by National Dope Testing Laboratory with the National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research-Guwahati.
 
• These are the purest form of chemicals required for anti-doping analysis in all WADA-accredited laboratories across the world.
 
 
 
• **Nisith Pramanik** is an Indian politician and a Union Minister of State, Ministry of Home Affairs and Minister of State, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports from West Bengal. 
 
• **Shri Ravi Mittal **took charge as Chairperson of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India in New Delhi.
 
• **Usha Sharma** served as the Director General of the Archaeological Survey of India from 2017 - 2020.
